# Sample competitive exam 2024
Exam: Sample competitive exam
Subject: Quantitative Aptitude

Q.1 A value increases from 20 to 25. What is the percentage increase?
(a) 20%
(b) 25%
(c) 5%
(d) 125%

Q2. Which statement is true?
A. The number 2 is even.
B. The number 3 is even.

## Answer Key

2. A
